note: RBC Royal Bank (Trinidad and Tobago), in its guide to the ACH payment template (read 2026-10-30, undated): the routing number that identifies the payee's bank is nine digits, the first a zero (its list: 010100039 RBC, 010100903 Republic Bank, and others); account lengths vary from bank to bank, Republic Bank's being 12 digits. Republic Bank is the country's largest, so twelve is written. A participant's guide, not the Central Bank's or the clearing house's own rule: the Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago's page wasn't read. The form draws all nine routing digits; the leading zero isn't pinned. No check digit is stated.

sources.title: RBC Royal Bank (Trinidad and Tobago), Guidelines on the use of the electronic payment template for payroll and miscellaneous credits
sources.said: These routing numbers are 9 digits long with the first digit being a zero. ... Account number lengths vary from bank to bank. ... Republic Bank 12 digits
